integrity: An analytic proof provides exact conditional face updates, closed mixed moments, strict all-size covariance sign, and a nonzero asymptotic correlation. A separate graph-enumeration checker supplies finite reproducibility checks and does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two distinct vertices of the initial clique, with uniform selection from all existing k-cliques and fixed integer k>=2; no assertion for later-born pairs or alternative growth rules. The no-coverage finding is qualified by the possibility of a broader unlocated abstract urn theorem.
title: Strict seed-degree anticorrelation in uniformly grown random \(k\)-trees
